purpose: `loadStyle({ fetchRemote, fallbackUrl, cacheKey })` reads the app's style sheet, validates it, and keeps exactly one `<style id="gilb-style">` in `<head>`.
namedChanges: the source's tests moved from `test/` to `src/` with their imports made relative to the file; the shared sheet fixture is `src/fixtures.ts`;
`@types/culori` is a dependency, not a dev dependency, because the unit is installed as TypeScript source and the app type-checks it;

library.title: Apply the app's style at start (style tokens)
library.note: loadStyle writes the CSS custom properties from one style.tokens.json, validated, no flash, with an offline fallback. Every new app takes it by default.
